fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 98 days adds timing risk.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (281), strong dollar pressures multinationals, FOMC just concluded; ABBV faces compounded cyclical and currency headwinds despite 98-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Intermediate bullish structure (EMA 50/200 cross, Ichimoku above cloud, SuperTrend) with oversold conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R) in fear-zone market presents contrarian reversal setup near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), zero momentum confirmation (RSI neutral, ADX 12.45 no trend), no volume support (OBV false), earnings risk in 98 days, and price below short-term EMAs (9/21) create compounded risk that outweighs technical oversold setup.
